daily.title: Billionaire Leon Black skips US congressional deposition over Epstein ties
daily.summary: The billionaire investor instead files a lawsuit challenging the subpoenas from the US congressional committee, which is looking into Jeffrey Epstein's links to the rich and powerful.

daily.title: European allies sound alarm at more incidents of alleged Russian sabotage
daily.summary: A suspected arson attack at a German defence manufacturer comes just a day after two separate attempts to sabotage the country's power grid.

daily.title: 'Soiled' undies and vicious friends research honoured at Ig Nobels
daily.summary: Each year, the Ig Nobel prizes celebrate research that makes you laugh, then makes you think. This year's winners include an "underwear index", a cumbersome kissing definition and why we want friends that will happily stab someone in the eye.

daily.title: Labor shuts down course linked to student visa misuse
daily.summary: The federal government is preventing new enrolments in a graduate diploma it fears is being used by non-genuine international students to switch courses and prolong their stay in Australia.

daily.title: UN warns El Niño could be strongest in decades
daily.summary: The El Niño weather phenomenon is set to intensify further into 2027 and could be the strongest ever, says the World Meteorological Organization.

daily.title: Feminist icon Gloria Steinem dies aged 92
daily.summary: With her trademark streaked hair parted down the middle and large aviator glasses, Gloria Steinem, a co-founder of Ms. Magazine, was a hugely recognisable presence wherever she went.

daily.title: V/Line CEO jailed and facing deportation over secret commissions
daily.summary: James Pinder is sentenced for misconduct in awarding a multi-million dollar cleaning contract.

daily.title: Hawks complete stunning upset over Freo to clinch prelim berth
daily.summary: Hawthorn will host an MCG preliminary final after an upset 32-point win over minor premier Fremantle in Perth.

daily.title: Broncos send Haas out a winner with top score of 2026 against Dogs
daily.summary: The Broncos win a final-round contest against the Bulldogs 34-20, in a game that doubled as superstar prop Payne Haas's farewell from Brisbane.

daily.title: They had no place in Sydney's gang war. They died anyway
daily.summary: In a new wave of organised crime violence on Sydney's streets, family, friends and innocent bystanders are no-longer safe. Here are their stories.

daily.title: Realtor raided after allegations agent sold client's home to himself
daily.summary: Authorities have raided the offices of Ideal Realty amid a probe into allegations the Perth property firm's licensees used a shell company to buy their own client's home without telling him.

daily.title: Farmstay guest maintains denial, no remorse over woman's manslaughter
daily.summary: The final moments of Maree Vermont's life remain unknown as her killer maintains he has no memory of what he did.

daily.title: Teachers hit back at Nationals claim about 'anti-boy' ideology in schools
daily.summary: A teacher's union has fired back, labelling the remarks a "malevolent mischaracterisation" that is "fundamentally incorrect".

daily.title: Boy, 16, sentenced for black swan cruelty captured on video
daily.summary: A 16-year-old boy who forced a black swan to inhale vape fumes in a video shared on social media has been sentenced to a fourth-month community-based order.

daily.title: Guide dog dragged by train along Flinders Street Station platform
daily.summary: Metro Trains apologises after a train failed to stop as it started dragging a guide dog along the station platform when its leash became caught in a train door.

daily.title: Billionaire's Tasmanian trainwreck has broken workers and marriages
daily.summary: Locals fear the closure of another smelter in Tasmania will be disastrous for the economy as anger brews over the federal government's failure to offer a bailout.

daily.title: Man who performed Nazi salute in public has not rehabilitated, court hears
daily.summary: Zachery James Hook pleaded guilty in June to making a Nazi salute in public and behaving offensively on Commonwealth premises.

daily.title: Hundreds of regional doctors stop work over poor working conditions

daily.title: Chalmers can't avoid questions on house prices, Marles learns from melon saga

daily.title: Tasmanian government chasing $1m in meal costs after prison kitchen slip-up
daily.summary: The Tasmanian government is hoping to recover the more than $1 million it has spent on food for the Risdon Prison population after its new $20 million kitchen's floor was deemed too slippery to safely use.

daily.title: Support worker accused of sexually assaulting two women in his care

daily.title: Sabalenka fumes over reporter's 'parties' claim after US Open win

daily.title: Small businesses scan for fake cash as counterfeit seizures soar
